title: Quad SPI slave: standard mode (MOSI on io[0], MISO on io[1]) and quad mode (a nibble per SCLK on io[3:0], read or write)
features: QSPI slave, mode 0, MSB first, 8-bit frames, selectable with MODE: standard SPI (1 bit per clock) or quad (4 bits per clock).
Standard mode: `io[0]` is MOSI and `io[1]` is MISO; `io[3:2]` are not driven.
Quad mode: DIR selects the direction. DIR = 0 drives `io[3:0]` with the TX byte, high nibble first; DIR = 1 releases the pins and receives a byte as two nibbles.
The first bit or nibble of a frame shows on the pins as soon as CSn falls, from the current TX value.
CSn high resets the bit and nibble counters.
Interrupt BYTE once per received byte.

words.name: TX
words.desc: Byte shifted out (MISO in standard mode, io[3:0] in a quad read)

words.name: DIR
words.desc: Bit 0, quad mode: 0 the slave drives io[3:0] (read), 1 it releases them (write) (write-only)

irqs.name: BYTE
irqs.desc: a byte was received (eight standard or two quad SCLK rising edges)

notes: sclk, csn and io are the QSPI pins; they pass through unchanged. SCLK is sampled on clk: it must stay high and low at least two clocks each.
